title: Return of the 8th Class Magician
altTitles: The Return of the 8th Class Magician
The Return of the 8th Class Mage

description: Ian Paige, an immensely powerful eighth-class mage, is betrayed and poisoned by Emperor Ragnar, his former friend and ruler. Using time magic, Ian returns thirty years into the past in his younger body. Determined to change his fate, surpass his former self, and take revenge on Ragnar, he begins rebuilding his power and preparing for the future.
author: Ryu Song
